scope: Published headless metadata engine only; no browser/audio playback/render/RPC/model testing

checks.name: Stable supplied clip/track IDs survive ingestion
Move preserves source trim and other track
Undo and redo preserve clip identity/placement
Grouped edits undo in one step
Split conserves source interval and duration
Existing overlap can be represented at ingestion

observations.name: same_track_overlap
observations.implication: Intentional same-track overlap needs an adapter/policy change or separate tracks; do not silently clamp an accepted server edit.

observations.name: refresh_history
observations.implication: Server revision/CAS and persistent undo must be owned outside local engine history; setTracks resets local history.

observations.name: state_ownership
observations.implication: Treat returned clip objects as immutable or clone at the adapter boundary; not a server isolation/CAS layer.
